related.title: OpenFeature：穩定分桶與可回復功能旗標
related.titleEn: OpenFeature: stable bucketing and reversible feature flags
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 targets.csv、故障/對照比較與abort紀錄。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver targets.csv,fault/control comparisons and abort evidence.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 逐id列桶與兩個旗標，確認50與100且舊群無流失；此均勻列舉非真實hash樣本的統計保證。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Enumerate IDs,buckets and both flags,verify50 and100 with no lost original members;this balanced enumeration is not a statistical guarantee for real hashes. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 3/20*100 = 15 percent-of-inventory；對照 1/20*100 = 5 percent-of-inventory。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐Pod求namespace與label交集，先列3個候選id，再選1個確定id；程序只改記憶體事件，不連線叢集。

基準 1000*5/100 = 50 users；對照 1000*10/100 = 100 users。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐id列桶與兩個旗標，確認50與100且舊群無流失；此均勻列舉非真實hash樣本的統計保證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 3/20*100 = 15 percent-of-inventory; comparison 1/20*100 = 5 percent-of-inventory. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Evaluate namespace and label intersections,print three candidate IDs and choose one deterministic target;the program only changes in-memory events.

Baseline 1000*5/100 = 50 users; comparison 1000*10/100 = 100 users. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Enumerate IDs,buckets and both flags,verify50 and100 with no lost original members;this balanced enumeration is not a statistical guarantee for real hashes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 從零重播與從e2後快照120接續e3兩路結果均140；每個事件最多套用一次。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Full replay and replay from the post-e2 snapshot120 followed by e3 both yield140;apply each event at most once. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
